_doc: Per-tier budgets for the mountain showcase census (scripts/perfBudget.mjs, docs/DECISIONS.md). Counts are the scene-graph census (visible meshes, upper bound, no frustum culling), set at about 10 % over what was measured on 2026-10-30. Lower these when a PR makes the scene lighter; raising one needs a reason in docs/DECISIONS.md. Shadow numbers are 0 at Low (no shadow pass). loadMsFail is JS-only boot time on a slow CI box (measured 12-20 s) and only catches a blow-up.
